---
title: "3) Daily series"
lang: en
---

**Daily** mean (`P1D`, the finest granularity of the API) of CH4 over Brazil.
The Statistical API aggregates on the server: you get the series ready, without
downloading images.

::: {.callout-note}
Not every day has an observation. Coverage increases over the years (it starts
lower in 2019 and approaches 100% in recent years).
:::

## Code

```python
import tropomi_ch4 as tch4
from tropomi_ch4 import plot

# One request per year (more robust to failures)
df = tch4.daily(start="2019-01-01", end=None)   # None = up to today
df.to_csv("serie_diaria_ch4_brasil.csv", index=False)

plot.plot_series(df, title="Daily mean CH4 over Brazil — TROPOMI",
                 outfile="serie_diaria_ch4_brasil.png")
```

Columns:

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `data` | observation date |
| `ch4_ppb` | mean CH4 (ppb) over Brazil |
| `n_validos` | number of valid pixels |
| `ano`, `mes` | helpers |

Notebook: [`notebooks/01_diaria.ipynb`](https://github.com/LudimiladeAzevedoBeltran/tropomi-ch4-brasil/blob/main/notebooks/01_diaria.ipynb).
